plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Taxi Ai to find nearby jobs and share your location when you choose to start active work tracking.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Taxi Ai to share your location during an active ride or delivery, including when your screen is locked. Sharing starts only when you choose and can be stopped at any time.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Taxi Ai to take your driver selfie, licence, food or vehicle photo when you choose to add one.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow Taxi Ai to use the driver document, food or vehicle photo you select.

plugins.motionPermission: Allow Taxi Ai to check for possible impacts while you enable foreground safety monitoring.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Taxi Ai to check sound levels for possible distress only while you enable foreground monitoring. Audio is not saved or uploaded.
